links.outcome: Reading level (FKGL) of LLM-simplified diabetes responses and user satisfaction
links.effect: MediClear consistently reduced reading level of generated responses to the recommended patient literacy range, with high user satisfaction and willingness for future use (10 participants).
links.quote: Results show that MediClear consistently reduces the reading level of generated responses to the recommended patient literacy range while achieving high user satisfaction and willingness for future use.

unlisted_practices: Retrieval-augmented generation over curated public diabetes sources to produce simplified patient explanations

screen.reason: Empirically evaluates an LLM system (MediClear) utilizing RAG and text simplification for diabetes education using readability metrics and a 10-participant human evaluation study.
